title: Review of the fed-vortex selection claim (SIDH) with the identical-draw neutral twin on fresh seed 17: kind b reaches 0.87 vs 0.47, births b:a 181:38 vs 44:64; daughters keep the kind at 201/219 splits; kinds are weak mixtures (median purity 0.64-0.78)
summary: Ran the author's heredity.py (labkit segmentation and tracker on |omega| every 3 t, K=20) on fresh seed 17 to T=4500 in both arms (eps 0.2 and eps 0, mut_dt 50, same mutation draw sequence), and a labkit pack of the favoured arm (seed 17, 1500 frames of 3 t). Favoured arm: mean b share over t>=2000 0.87, births b:a 181:38, daughters of the parent's kind 201/219, 84 mutations, kind flips of living vortices 37 at a mutation and 19 elsewhere, median purity 0.78 (p10 0.55). Neutral twin: 0.47, births 44:64, 94/108, flips 39 at a mutation and 4 elsewhere, purity 0.64 (p10 0.52). labkit pack: 114 persistent splits, generation 17, merge/split 0.91.

observations.S: rerun_sel_s17/sheet.png t=0: band-passed random vorticity over the whole domain; ~35 discrete vortices by t=189.
observations.I: rerun_sel_s17/sheet.png t=189-4500: 30-40 discrete vortices, round (kind a, pink) or elongated (kind b, green), persisting between fusions and splits.
observations.D: rerun_sel_s17/metrics.json: 114 persistent splits, generation 17; heredity/m_s17_e0.2.json: 219 persistent splits after labelling.
observations.H: heredity/share_s17.png: from one b vortex at t=315 the favoured arm reaches b share 0.8-0.95 from t~1600 (mean 0.87 over t>=2000) while the identical-draw twin wanders 0.3-0.65 (mean 0.47); births by kind b:a 181:38 vs 44:64; daughters of the parent's kind 201/219 (favoured) and 94/108 (twin).

seeds_run.result: pass: b share 0.87 vs 0.47 in the identical-draw twin; births b:a 181:38 vs 44:64; fidelity 201/219; labkit 114 persistent splits, gen 17

controls_run.H: heredity/m_s17_e0.json: eps 0 twin with the same mutation draw sequence, seed 17

verdicts.limitation: Kinds are majority labels of mixed vortices (median purity 0.78 favoured, 0.64 twin; p10 ~0.52-0.55), and 8% (favoured) to 13% (twin) of daughters fall on the other side of 0.5 from their parent; 19 kind flips of living vortices in the favoured arm happen away from a logged mutation (4 in the twin), likely fusions of a with b. The fitness effect is written (the label scales the gain) and also changes the phenotype: b vortices are longer and divide about twice as often (219 vs 108 splits), which is the mechanism of selection. Mutation is frequent and symmetric (84 per run), so the twin drifts to ~0.5. One fresh seed; no dt or grid variant; E not claimed.
